title: Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into interactive video explanations that respond directly to user queries. A user uploads a PDF and asks a question; the system then generates a video-based explanation as output, handling both text and visual elements from the PDF for multi-modal retrieval and response generation. The pipeline combines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model with generative multimedia components. The RAG stage is optimized for the structure of NCERT textbooks and performs best on content from those books. Given a user query, the RAG model retrieves relevant content from the PDF and generates a multi-scene script containing narrative explanations and structured visual prompts aligned with the textbook's explanatory style. translated_title: 动态学习解决方案：一个个性化教育视频生成系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种自动化流水线，将NCERT（印度国家教育研究与培训委员会）教科书转换为可直接响应用户查询的交互式视频讲解。用户上传PDF并提出问题后，系统会生成基于视频的讲解作为输出，处理PDF中的文本和视觉元素，以实现多模态检索和响应生成。该流水线将检索增强生成（RAG）模型与生成式多媒体组件相结合。RAG阶段针对NCERT教科书的结构进行了优化，在这些书籍的内容上表现最佳。给定用户查询，RAG模型从PDF中检索相关内容，并生成包含叙述性解释和与教科书讲解风格一致的结构化视觉提示的多场景脚本。这些提示被传递给一个Stable Diffusion模块，该模块逐层实现以提高可解释性和可控性，生成与上下文相关的图像。
tldr: 本文提出一种自动化系统，将NCERT教科书PDF转换为能直接响应用户提问的交互式教育视频，通过结合RAG模型与Stable Diffusion图像生成模块实现多模态检索与视频讲解的自动生成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated system that converts NCERT textbook PDFs into interactive educational videos responding directly to user queries, combining a RAG model with a layer-wise Stable Diffusion image generation module for multi-modal retrieval and video explanation generation.
